notes.title: Friends Forever Update
notes.notes:
We’re happy to finally be able to share our new update with y'all! This update brings a range of improvements and new content as well as a great new feature for players to connect with each other across platforms. 

Connect with your friends!
We’ve added a room code system so players can more easily join their friends.
This system works cross play and means you can easily join your friends’ games by sharing your room code and connecting directly to them. 

To join a friend’s game simply let them know your room code, which you can find in the pause menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32557381/e09d6529759dfa802d608e773cd5df840c7914e2.png

Then they can then select “Join with code” from the Pause menu, enter your room code, and confirm to connect to your room.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32557381/3df19e4684b563486592145afab158eae80b78f9.png

Other Platforms
This patch is launching synchronously across all platforms except Xbox, due to some issues. So if you’re trying to play with friends on Xbox, hold tight as we’re still working on getting it out there. 

New Content

 We’ve extended the second island significantly with a new hidden area, players who were previously obsessed with the triangle ruin in the snow will be pleasantly surprised
 In this new area you’ll be able to find an awesome new song by our composer
 We’ve hidden 5 new birds across the maps, these include some much requested birds :)


Improvements

 Birds now have different sizes to help give them more personality
 Added some butterflies to the first island


Fixes

 Fixed music bug where it would stop if you flew through 2 or more runes in a row
 Fixed some holes on the map
 Fixed a soft lock when you disconnect in the main menu
 Fixed a bug where joining a friend during rewind would cause the greyscale effect to stay on
 Fixed bug where players could get stuck loading into second island

notes.title: Explorer Update
notes.notes:
Hi Friends!

We’re pleased to announce that the Explorer Update is now live. Along with this update the game is now available on both Xbox One and PS4 which means you’ll be seeing lots of new birds around!!

Major New Additions for this Update
Full Crossplay with all platforms including the new PS4 and Xbox One releases!

A new area has been added to the game, it’s hidden within the islands so have fun finding it. 

Added 4 new birds to find 

Added Mac Support (we did the proper thing so it doesn’t show the scary dialogue box when you open it)

Along with the new area are 6 new songs to discover, listen to the new soundtrack  outside of the game here. 


Improvements

 Added small details to the existing islands
 New weather conditions have started occurring, on some days it will get really windy. 
 New procedural spawning allows us to spawn way more small grass/shrubs on the surface of the island.
 Added more perchable areas to the existing map
 Resolution settings are now much more compressed (the extended list is available using a launch command)
 The camera is now less likely to freak out as much when diving at extreme angles
 Added smooth crossfading to some previously noticeable popping assets
 Added wing flap sound triggers to all bird flap animations 
 Wind trails will be slightly smoother now
 Added different fish to be caught



Bug Fixes

 Audio settings should now properly apply when loading the game
 Hitting start too early when the game starts will no longer soft lock the game
 Bird trails no longer emit when rewinding after a crash
 You should no longer catch fish when rewinding after a crash
 Fixed many audio sources playing at zero volume and hogging audio channels fixing some sounds not playing when they should
 Controller should no longer vibrate if the keyboard is in use
 Fixed issue where shapeshifting runes would not reset properly unless the game was restarted



Experimental 
-renderer launch option replaced with -newrenderer , this can improve performance for some users, but has much lower compatibility on older GPUs


I wanna give a special shoutout to all our Feather friends in discord who have helped us test the build early and ensure it’s as stable as possible. We think this is the best version of Feather yet! As always if you want to join the community please head over to our Discord.

Much Love,
Samurai Punk
<3

A new patch is now available - it’s the island you love, but with more! Find your favourite bird and explore the new additions to the island in style.

Features

 Added bird customisation! You can now find runes around the island that will allow you to transform into new birds. 


Improvements

 Reworked the rocks near the geyser
 Polished ocean horizon visual
 The geyser now pushes you up if you’re inside it while it erupts
 The forest ambient sound now has less ambient birds
 Added fog gates to make transition into/out of caves look better


Join our official Discord at discord.gg/samuraipunk to find yourself some new chirpy friends!

Much Love,
Samurai Punk
<3

notes.title: Feather Patch 1.0.2 Has been released!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557381/0e846ab225f71ac3253d39e81a4d2eb1bca98f97.png
Patch 1.0.2 Has been released!
It has been an exciting release week, watching so many enjoy Feather! A few issues have cropped up and a few that we didn't have time to fix for release. So we have been heads down working on these polish and bug fixes since release.
The main things:

- Added the ability to turn of the auto recenter for the Free Cam. (with it off you can click the right stick or right click to return to center)
- Fixed up the sensitivity setting for keyboard and mouse to correctly scale the rate at which you speed up to a full turn.
- Fixed the Tutorial on PC
- Tutorial Text is also now centred correctly
- Various audio bugs with hearing other birds wings and collisions
- Changed the default inversion settings for flight to better represent players expectation
- Added Multi-Bird support for visual effects.
- Fixed fog getting stuck on after perching inside the caves. or getting stuck in the caves.

We hope that you continue to enjoy your time with Feather. 

Still working on trying to get OSX & Linux working, its... proving difficult with our fancy shaders

Much Love,
Samurai Punk <3
